video_title: Steph Curry's Contract Decision Is Coming — Anthony Slater

quotes.speaker: Anthony Slater
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors are not negotiating against Steph Curry's contract extension
quotes.excerpt: they're not like negotiating with Steph Curry right now. They are saying, here's your menu, pick off your menu.
quotes.quote: They are adamant they're not like negotiating with Steph Curry right now. They are saying, you can do this, you can do this, you can do this. If you want the one-year max, if you want the two-year max, if you want to wait, here's your menu, pick off your menu.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Slater
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors have generated significant flexibility with recent contract decisions
quotes.excerpt: they've generated an incredible amount of flexibility with almost all of their contracts.
quotes.quote: They've generated an incredible amount of flexibility with almost all of their contracts. Bringing Draymond Green back on the one-year, Porzingis with only 3 million guaranteed next year, we can go down the list. Steph Curry is not a guy that they're going to force into a flexible contract that he may not want at the end of his career. Steph Curry gets what he wants, but he's also being presented various options to choose from.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Slater
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors maintain significant cap space flexibility for next summer
quotes.excerpt: they have 45 million in cap space still next summer. You can add 17 million to that.
quotes.quote: They have 45 million in cap space still next summer. You can add 17 million to that if you cut Kristaps Porzingis. So that's still max cap space next summer, which creates an enormous amount of flexibility. Steph Curry is not a guy that they're going to force into a flexible contract that he may not want at the end of his career.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Slater
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry's contract situation mirrors Draymond Green's previous flexibility
quotes.excerpt: it's a little bit like the Draymond situation, right? He gave back 27 million and kept his business.
quotes.quote: It's a little bit like the Draymond situation, right? He gave back 27 million and kept his business on hold and said, let's all go try to get LeBron James. Once they didn't, they gave him the 27 million back. If you're Steph, you don't have to lock in at this point to a lower number. You can just say, if you are able to execute something, I might be willing to sign that, but I don't have to confirm that at this point.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Slater
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry would likely take the max contract extension
quotes.excerpt: I would not be shocked if he takes the max.
quotes.quote: I would not be shocked if he takes the max. I would probably be a little bit more surprised if he locked into a haircut now. Now again, he might be a wait and see thing, what can and can't get done.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Slater
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors have multiple paths to build around Steph Curry
quotes.excerpt: there's other ways to build teams even though with Steph on a max.
quotes.quote: The Warriors should, even if Steph Curry is on a max contract, they have a ton of flexibility. If they hit on Yaxell Lindberg for example, if this guy becomes like a really high-level starter, he's on a four-year 28 million dollar deal. There's other ways to build teams even though with Steph on a max, and they'll have a ton of flexibility.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Slater
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic's contract approach provides a template for Steph Curry
quotes.excerpt: a little bit like Jokic is doing in Denver, right? Jokic is not signing the extension.
quotes.quote: A little bit like Jokic is doing in Denver, right? Jokic is not signing the extension. Well, every quote from Jokic is I want to be in Denver forever. That quiets the noise to a degree. That's all Steph has ever done. To your question of if a decision is made, I would expect one way or the other Steph's mind wanting to be cleared by then.
